Paragraph: But ignorant and faithless persons who doubt the revealed scriptures do not attain God consciousness. For the doubting soul there is happiness neither in this world nor in the next.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Cynicism, persistent self-doubt, and skepticism paralyzing constructive action and joy.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna states: 'But ignorant and faithless persons who doubt the revealed scriptures do not attain God consciousness. For the doubting soul there is happiness neither in this world nor in the next.'
Outcome/Resolution: Recognizing that chronic doubt paralyzes human potential and robs the individual of happiness in any realm.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Perils of Cynicism: Understanding how ungrounded skepticism undermines happiness and personal growth
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Decisiveness over Doubt: Overcoming paralysis caused by endless, unproductive questioning
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Cultivating Trust: Developing healthy faith as a foundation for mental well-being and action

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Jnas casraddadhanas ca samsayatma vinasyati (The ignorant, faithless, and doubting soul perishes)
Nayam loko 'sti na paro na sukham samsayatmanah (For the doubting soul there is neither this world, nor the next, nor happiness)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Chronic doubt and lack of faith block self-realization, cutting one off from joy in both material and spiritual life.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Compulsive skepticism leads to cognitive paralysis and unhappiness; committed belief is necessary for progress.
